name: Tomasz Lindqvist
headline: Backend Engineer
summary: Versatile software engineer with experience across frontend, full-stack, and backend delivery in product-focused teams. Comfortable turning business needs into reliable features, improving internal workflows, and supporting production systems. Known for practical problem solving, clear communication, and steady delivery across changing priorities.

roles.title: Junior Frontend Developer
bullets: Built and maintained interface features for internal tools, using Git and SQL to keep work coordinated and data-driven.
Updated existing screens and fixed defects, then verified changes against stored records in SQL before release.
Collaborated with designers and analysts to refine user flows and keep tracked work organized in Git.
Helped reduce rework by documenting recurring issues and sharing clearer handoff notes with the team.

roles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Delivered customer-facing features in JavaScript and Vue, connecting them to services backed by MongoDB and SQL.
Refined the application data handling so key user journeys stayed consistent across modules and reports.
Worked with product and support partners to translate requests into manageable frontend and backend changes.
Improved release readiness by reviewing edge cases and validating data updates across MongoDB and SQL.

roles.title: Backend Engineer
bullets: Built backend services in Express on AWS, using PostgreSQL to store operational data for internal and customer workflows.
Set up GitHub Actions checks and Docker-based delivery steps to make deployments more repeatable for the team.
Strengthened service safety by applying OWASP guidance, then added Playwright coverage for critical flows.
Partnered on System design discussions to simplify dependencies and keep response times stable under load.
Supported incident follow-up by tracing data issues in PostgreSQL and restoring service behavior quickly.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Systems
